scheme_name: Sona Sobaran Dhoti Saree Distribution Scheme
other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Jharkhand.
Applicant should have a valid Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) or Priority Household (PHH) card under NFSA, 2013.
Green Card holders under the Jharkhand State Food Security Scheme (JSFSS) are eligible.
Applicant must possess or apply for an Aadhaar number.
benefits_summary: One dhoti or lungi and one saree are provided to eligible families at subsidized rates annually.
